segments.name: Banking
segments.description: A community-focused financial holding company providing banking, insurance, wealth management and related services to customers.
segments.evidence: The Company is engaged in the business of banking through its wholly owned subsidiary, First Mid Bank & Trust, N.A. ("First Mid Bank").

changes.text: In 2023 the Company acquired Blackhawk Bank, which was merged into First Mid Bank.
changes.evidence: On August 15, 2023, the Company acquired Blackhawk Bank, which was merged into First Mid Bank on December 1, 2023.

changes.text: In 2024 the Company acquired Mid Rivers Insurance Group, Inc., which was merged into First Mid Insurance.
changes.evidence: During the quarter ended September 30, 2024, the Company acquired Mid Rivers Insurance Group, Inc. which was subsequently merged into First Mid Insurance.
